rules: Red Player card for Hong Kong. Not a port: the compass has no anchor.
One SEARCH box. State 2 is that box scratched. Side A stays the Player deck back.
The scratch reveals Companion Structural Engineer. When you take the Build Shelter action, you may discard a City card of any color, including this card, if this card is in your hand.
The companion is not played and removed. It works while the card stays in hand. The word is "may," so a matching-color discard is still allowed.
notes: Card id 10711. State 2 card id 10726. One copy.
